Ngi

mut shuwa ka Baiseng ha ki lyngkha ba bun bah ka khaii ka pateng bad ka trei ka ktah. Ngi hap tuklar ban pynkhlain ia ki Bo. kynshew-pisa kum ka bor-kyrshan na ka bynta ban pynmih ki lad Bats*,.#. Ka Bor Kynshew Bai Seng ka dei ha khmat eh ban pynroi khaii. la lea ktien Synniang pat ngi mut Ka Bor Kynshew Balang kaba pynmih ia ka Baiseng Khaii na ka jingkynshew lang da ka ling, ka Kynhun ne ka Shnong. Tang ba ka Bor- Kynshew pynmih Baiseng ia ka khaii pateng khamtam ha ki shnong kyndong ka dei ban khlain nangne shakhmat. Hynrei lada ngi long kiba duk, kiba tlot, ki byn lah bor bad khlem ka jingangnud bad jingkut-jingmut- ka long kaba eh da shisha ban khie-khlieh, ban roi ban manbha. Ka shi tyngka bad artyngka kaba sah tarn shi sngi wat na ka kam bylla-ka long ka umpohliew kaba kyrshan bad ka bor lada ngi thep man ka sngi ha ka pla KYNSIT baheh bad ngi sei ia kane ka jingkynshew ba kordor ynda la kut shisnem. Ka paw shai ha ki hajar bad ki phew hajar ki iing bad ki shnong ki don, ym dei hajrong, hynrei ki hiar shapoh u pud ka jinghiran khait : ka shongnia kum kiba shemphang, kumno ngin ia buh kti ban iarap ia kiba hiran khait bad ki shemlanot kiba ia trei bad ia ksaid bad pyndonkam shisha ia ka jingiarap. Ngi kynnoh ba ka dei ka jing bym iohkam bad ki lad ai jingtrei kiba wanlam ia ki kam basniew bad kiba pynjot. Ka jingjied ka dei ka jong ngi hi lada ia ki kam pynjot ne ia ki kam iatei. Lada ngim don ka jingangnud ban im bad khih ban trei wat ia kano kano ka kam kaba den naphang, kata ka long hi, ka jingiap. Ngi iohi bun ki briew ki iaksaid bad trei naphang ha iew ha hat, ha khlaw ha btap, khlem khein ia ki kyrdan, hynrei hadien ki bit ki biang bad ki man bha. Ka jingbymiaineh ha ka kam ruh ka la pynthut

ia ki kyrdan bad rukom trei kam. Ngim pat lah pynkut ba ka tufa, ka lute, ka shohnoh bad pyniap ka khie bad jyllei, tang na ka daw, bym ioh kam. Ka jinglyngkar ka ioh ban rung namar ka jingkit khlieh ka duna b palat, ka jinglong lyngkar, ka phriang namar ka jing bym burom ia ka imlang ka trei jur. Kum ki nongshong-shnong, ngim shym pynkhreh ba ngin long ki nongshong shnong bakitkhlieh bad ba shakri. Ngim pat pynkhamti ha ki khun samla ia ki rukom pyntbit ha ka jingshakri. Ka jingtrei-kitkhlieh kam ju don ka jingsngew khohnioh, ka jingkhnium bad jingwit. Ka iarap ban khyllie ia ka Tip-Briew Tip-Blei, ka jingshemphang, ka akor ka buit bad ka spah mynsiem. Ban pynlait ialade, na ka jingthala, da ka jingtrei aiti lut; ka jingkyrduh kam, ka dung shisha lymdangi shimti ban trei ia ki kam naphang ryngkat bad ka sei-bor- lade. Lada ngim don ka jingsngew-kitkhlieh ialade, khlem pep, ngin kyllon bad iap ei. Ka jingthmu ba kongsan ka long ban wallam ka Jingiatyili ryngkat bad ka jingkhlain ban pynshong skhem ia ka ia Trei-lang bad ka jingiarap markylliang, pyrshah, ia ka jingsngewthut ha ka longiing longsem, bad ki jingsngew-iapher ha shnong ha thaw, kine ki dei ki daw rem daw jot, lyngba kajingiapait bad iathut para mangi. Ban iada kumjuh, na ki bor bapynpra jong ka politik-namar Iada ngim pynkhlain ia ka Sain-iatylli jong ka Imlang, kine ki bor pynpra, kin rong ia ngi baroh shapoh riat : ban wallam ruh ka jingithuh-ithaw ba kham bha-ka iatrei lang bad ka ia kyrshan bor ha ka khaii pateng bad ka trei ka ktah ba bun ki liang.

KaTrei shitom jong ka Jaidbynriew shityllup kam lah ban lait Iada ngi kwah ba ka Pateng jong ngi ka shong skhem lashai lashisngi. Ka Jingiatyili bad ka Jingiatrei lang ka long ka bor batei, pyrshah ia ki kam awria, ka tamasa bad rongphong. Khamtam ban sei ia ka Dur bad ka Longrynnieng jong ka Jaidbynriew jong ngi ha khmat shisnieh pyrthei bad kloi kloi katba lah ban sei ia ki Nongsaindur bad ki Nong trei lang ha ki jingshakri babun bah. Ka Jingkyrshan ia ki Seng Kyntiew Ri, Seng Shakri, Seng Leh Isynei ka long bym lah lait. i Ban pynlong ia ki samla kiba khlain bad pynioh ia ki jingtbit ha ki kam iatrei ha shnong ha thaw ban pynioh ha ki samla ka jmgsngew-brai ha ki jingshakri la ka imlang.” c 1 • KI JINGKYNTHOH IA KA JAIDBYNR1EW “In a recent paper.... Luce has called irrigated rice the prime prod- uct of South-East Asia, and one of the great discoveries of humanity. The rubicon between dry and wet rice he claims was crossed by the advanced Mon-Khmer speaking people of Indo-China Peninsula. They pioneed its cultivation, in the delta of Red river in Tonking. Their efforts, he thinks caused a population explosion. This in turn led to the other delta areas and foundation of centres of wet rice cultivation near the mouths of the Mekong, the Menam and the Irrawadi. ... When the Tonking plain was overran by the Vietnamese, the majority of the wet rice cultivators living there, went up the Red river to

Yunnan, then escaping westwards from the cold, high plateau of Central Yunnan, they followed the Red river to its source, south of Tali, made their way across northern Burma to Khasi in the plain of East Assam where they established a new centre. The main body, however, moved into the plain of Ganges whence Aryan penetration drove them into the hills of Central and Eastern India. Hence their descendants are met with today are speakers of the Munda language, and number some four mil- lions.” (G.E.Hail, History of South-East Asia, 1994, p.221). Kat kum u Luce, ka Jaidbynriew kaba kren ia ka ktien Mon Khmer ba ka Jaidbynriew ba kham stad ka la lap nyngkong ka rukom rep 3 ung bad rep hali ha ki rud-duriaw kiba ka wah Tonking ka tuid lyngba bad ka jingsdang rep kba ha ki sung ka la wallam ia ka jingiar bakhraw ha ka jingbunbriew jong ka jaidbynriew ba kren ia ka ktien Mon-Khmer (kaba ngi hiar pateng). Bad ka rep hali kumjuh ka la phriang ha ki shyntur jong ka wah Irrawadi, wah Mekong bad wah Menam. Halor ka jingiaknieh khyndew, kawei ka kynhun ka la ieh noh syndon ia la ki shnong bad ka la phet sha Yunnan lyngba ka phud wah jong ka Red river, na Yunnan ba la khriat palat, ka kynhun ka bud ter ter shaduh ki tlong jong kata ka wah, shaphang shathie na ka jaka ba la jer ka Tali, nangta sha Burma bashatei shaduh ki pyntha ka mihngi jong ka ri Assam kaba la ju khot mynshuwa ka Ri Khasi. Kawei pat ka kynhun ka tur shaphang sepngi sha ki rud ka wah Ganges nangta sha ki lum ka pdeng bad ka India mihngi kaba mynta ngi tip ia ka kum ka Munda bad kaba ka jingbunbriew ka la jan kot shaduh saw million ne. Kat kumba paw ka Jaidbynriew Khasi mynhyndai kulong ka la lap

1 nyngjkong eh ia ka Rep kba ha ki sung lane hali bah bad kaba pher bak-ly- bak na ka Rep thangram lane shyrti jhlaw. Kane ka Jaidbynriew ka la pynphriang ia ka Rep kba ha ki Ri kiba khraw bad ba kliam rit ha ka Ri Asia mihngi bad khadduh ka la wallam ia ka rukom Rep kba hali sha ka Upper Assam shwa ba ka Jaidbynriew jong ngi-ka wan hiar sha Lower Assam bad Meghalaya ha ki jaka kiba la sah jynduh bad synshar ruh kham stem lyngba ki pateng bajlan, tad haduh ka spah snem ba la dep. Kumta, ki Hima bakhraw bor ki la khie ha ki Sung-bah jong ka Hima Nongwah bad Kameikha, ka Hima Mangkathiang bad ka ri Bhoi : ka la khie ruh kumjuh ha ki phang pdeng turn Hima Malngiang, Shillong, kumjuh ki Sungbah kiba phriang hapoh ka Ri Pnar. Bad, hadien kawei pat ka kynhun ka la hiar sha ki ranab lum shathie bad ka la thung ia ki soh bun rukom, ki sla tyrpad, sohmarit, kwai bad tympew bad pynphriang ia ki Hima sha ki them Barak bad Surma. Ka kot ba la jer “Geological structure of part of the Khasi Hills” 1 854, u nongthoh, Thomas Oldham, u shem kumne: “a large proportion of potatoes is annually sent from the hills. For the most part these potatoes are purchased in small quantities in each family by Khasi merchants or by Bengalese who come up for the purpose and the accumulated store is then shipped from Pondua or Chattue (Chatak) to Calcutta. From the hills also, Culcutta and other places are principally supplied with pine-apples. They grow freely along the lower slopes of the hills, and are of good quality. The same plant furnishes the Khasi with the strong and the smooth fibre of which his netter pouch is made, and which is usefully applied in a

thousand other ways.” On oranges : “The first fruit is small roundish with rinds, and like the variety so well known at Malta under the name of Mandarin orange”. About orange plantation : “The orange groves stretch for miles along the flat ground just at the base of the hills, and are very well kept, and con- stantly renewed. The fruit is the only product of the trees more economised. The manufacture of flower water which in the south of Europe is so ex- tensively carried on, and which there forms a very considerable profits is here unknown”. Shaphang u shoniamtrai, la kynthoh : “of this fruit immense 2 numbers are annually sent to Calcutta”. Bun bah la shalan man ka snem sha Calcutta. U sohtrun u dei u mar shalan na ki lum Khasi sha Calcutta. "Ki ksai bani bad ba khlain jong u sohtrun ki pynbiang ia u kfaun Khasi ia !<i iarong iadap bad pla-kieng bad kiba leit kam ha ki jahar rukom ba u Khasi u pyndonkam. Ngim da tip thikna eh, la u shoniamtrai bad u sohtrun, tad haduh u snem 1 854 ki la khie bad sei ne em shawei sha-ar shabar ki pud jong ki Hima lum bad dkhar jong ka Ri Khasi ne ki khie shuwa hangne- nangta sa phriang shawei sha-ar. Kumjuh bunbah u phan lane sohlah la wan lum da ki khar Bengali bad mahajon Khasi na ki shnong ri lum jong ngi bad la kyntiew lieng ia u sohlah na Pandua lane Chattak. Hynrei u sohtrun, haba khein bha, urn long ei ei kum u shoniamtrai uba da ki thupbah thupsan shisnem shisnem la pynkit bad shalan”. La tip kumjuh ba u sohniamtrai na ri Khasi la pynkiew lieng bad la pynpoi ia u sha Middle East bad nangta sha Europe.

Ka Jingsyriem bad iapher had ka England (ne Bilat) Ka Himalayan Journal jong u Sir Joseph Hooker ba la shon ha ka spah snem ba la dep ka kynthoh : “The Khasi coal is excellent for many purposes. It was of the first quality and,gave great heat and a few ashes. ... We found it generally used by Assam steamers and where informed that her furnaces consumed 729 lbs. whereas Assam coal 900 lbs.” tJ dewiong Khasi u long uba bha bad uba da kynsai na ka bynta ki jingshakri ba bun. ... Ngi la shem ba la pyndonkam ia u da ki jhad Assam bad la iathuh ba ki atuskhana jhad ki bam tang 729 pound katba ia u dewiong Assam ki bam haduh 900 pound.” . “The quality of Khasi coal” Oldham remarked “has been frequently spoken of, ... as being greatly superior to the Burdwan ...and as being equal in every respect to English coal. The Cherra coal is undoubtedly superior to coal from Damoodah valley... and it is equally certain that it is equal to some English coals, but is is certainly inferior to others. It is quick in action and therefore would generate steam rapidly : It cakes well but gives a large amount of smoke, ... As a gas producing coal, it is supe- rior to good English coal. But as regards the quantity and quality of its gits with proper precautions in burning, it would yield a very passable coke”. La pynwan kumne harum “U dewiong Khasi uba la iohnam shikatta u long uba kham kynsai 3 ban ia u dewiong Burdwan bad u ia ryngkat dor nadong shadong bad u dewiong Bilat. U kham kynsai ban ia u dewiong na Damoodah bad la jan sbem thikna ba u iaiyngkat dor bad katto katne ki jaid dewiong na ri Bilat

hynrei u kham kordor ban ia kiwei pat. U trei bor stet bad pynmih j ingthnam bad jinhaw kloi lan, u rhem stet bad phuh phur phur wat la u sliew tdem kham bun. Ha ka jingpynmih pat u trei kham jlih bad kham donbor ban ia u English coal.” U Thomas Oldham u iaroh ia u mawshun Khasi kumne “Much of this limestone would produce most durable, and occasionally hansomely veined marble. It would answer well for ordi- nary purpose, chimney, pieces, slabs for tables, garden seats and for floor- ing tiles. Of the latter articles, I believe many hundreds are annually im- ported, of inferior colouring and beauty to those which could be manu- factured out of this Khasi limestone.” “Uba kham bun u bit bad iadei eh ban pynlong ia ki syrtap atuskhana, ki shynrong miej, syrtap kynroh iing, ki jaka shongkai ha ki kper bad ban pynlong ia ki tbian poh iing. Na ka bynta kine ki jingdonkam nga ngeit bun bah kum kitei ki mar la shalan na shabar kiba kham poh dur ha ka rong bad jingitynnad ban ia kito kiba ngi lah ban shna bad pynlong na kum une u mawshun Khasi.” U Oldham u kynthoh sa shisien :- (a) “the manipulative skills of some of the Khasi women ac- quired by long experience in these operations is very great indeed”. Tho- mas Oldham was referring to the washing of the blank are collected on the first stage of melting. Ki saptrei kam jong katto katne ki kynthei Khasi bad kiba la pyntrei la slem taid baroh shikatta ki long kiba khraw shikatdei eh. U Kynthoh hangne ia ki rukom trei kam ba ki sait bad pynkhuid ia u nar uba la lum

thup napoh ka um shuwa ban pynkylla ia u ha ka dur u nar-iew ne nar- bsap. Thomas Oldham also noted the marked difference in the using the hammer, as compared with that, which an English mechanic would adopt, <b) “for a Khasi smith unlike an English mechanic, never swings his 4 hammer, however, heavy but simply lifts it vertically and the force of the blow depends on the weight and impetus of the hammer itself s it falls rather on the mascular power of a persons who wields it A local'ham- mer composed of two lengths of iron rod forming a cross on one edge shows till date the iron handle and iron head of equal size and length and its head so pointed flat is not solidified or thickened, as in the case, of other communities. V U Kamar shlem Khasi ym kum u English mechanic um ju kaweh palat ia la u tymem hynrei u Khasi u rah pynsting ia la ka kti bad ka bor- shoh tymem ka shaniah ha ka jingkhia u tymem ban ha ka bor-tied u briew uba bom tymem: katba ka sain nar ka dang sah mynsiem kumba shispah snem lane kham palat mynshuwa. Haba U Iskat Saheb ryngkat bad u A. White kiwei ki saheb synshar ki la wan kiew sha Nongkhlaw bad wan poi ha ka 3 Naiwieng 1 826 na ka bynta ban pynshai ha khmat ka Dorbar Bah ka Hima kaba tohkit ia ka jingpom surok na Assam sha Shilot, la thoh ha ka Memoir of David Scott kumne:- “The attendants came up the hills, armed with swords, bows and quivers. The Rajah proceeded to explain the object of the meeting and

requested the different orators to express their sentiments on the proposi- tion of the British Government. The leading orator, on the part of the opposition immediately... commenced a long harangue in condemnation of the measures expressed in a continuous flow of language accompanied with much animation of manner and appropriate gesticulation. This was replied to by an orator of the Rajah’s party and in this way the ball was kept rolling until evening”. The official observed: “I was struck with astonishment at the order and decorum which character] cd these debates. No shout of exultation or indecent attemps to put down the orator of the opposite party was made. On the contrary, every speaker was fairly heard out. 1 have often witnessed the debates in St. Stephen's Chapel which is British Parliament” but those of the Khasi Parliament appeared to me to be conducted with more dignity of manner. As it grew dark, the debate not being closed, Mr. Scott rather grew impatient and as had been his wont with the Garos, ordered a dozen ex 5 rum to be sent up the hill in the hope of putting an end to it. The liquor was returned, with a message saying they would not drink sprit until they had come to the point at issue. The next morning the debate was resumed: it was continued through out the day and closed at midnight in favour of the proposition of the British Government. What the literal arguments of the orators were... I cannot exactly say. The next day the resolution of the Assembly was embodied in a Treaty which was concluded with the Brit- ish Government and the Khasis agreeing to aid in the construction of the road which was to pass through the territory”. About 500 or 600 hundred

member drawn from various place attended. “Ki dkhot ka Durbar kumba 500 lane 600 ki la wan ki da kiew lyngba u lum bad kiba da kieng atiar da ki waitlam, ki ryntieh bad ryngkab. U Syiem u la plie bad batai pynshai ia ka jingthmu jong ka Durbar bad u la bthah ia ki Nongkren paidbah (orators) ban ia-sam ia ki jingsngew jong ki halor ka jingsngew-donkam jong ka Sorkar phareng. U kongbah na ka Hang ba iapyrshah u la ieng bad u la sdang ia ka jingbatai bajlan un da pynrem jur ia ka jingwan pom surok bad u la bteng da ki kyntien kiba shu tuid jai jai ryngkat bad ka jingkhih ka met bad ka khmat kaba da i iahap bha. Halor kane, u kongbah na ka liang U syiem ruh, u la ai ka jubab bad kumta, ka la iaid haduh ka por premmiet. Ynda Ia dum, namar ba ka jingiasaid nia kam pat kut, u Saheb Scott um lah shah shuh bad u la phah shim shi-dorjon ki bitor rum da ka jingkyrmen ban pynwai noh ia ka. Hynrei ia ka kiad la pynphai noh, ryngkat bad ka jingbatai, ba kim ju mlien dih kiad, katba ka kam kam pat kut. Lashai dangstep, la sdang pat ia ka Durbar, ka la bteng baroh shisngi bad ka la kut haduh ka por shiteng synnia bad ki la rai ban pdiang ia ka jingtyrwa jong ka Sorkar dohlieh. Dei, ha ka sngi babud, la shim ia kane ka rai bad ki la buh ia ka ha ka jingiateh kular. Ka la ktah shibun eh ia nga ha kajingpyniaid ryntih bad ka jingshong khia ha kaba ki la pyaiaid beit ia ka jingiatai nia. Ym don satia kano kano ka kaw kaw lane ka iakawang ktieh ban pynshong noh ia u kongbah na ka liang pyrshah. Hynrei ha kaba shisha, ia uwei pa uwei u nongkren ia pynsngew bad shahshkor da baroh ki nongshong Durbar. Nga la ju iohi bunsien ia ka jingiatai nia ha ka St. Stephen’s Chapel” kaba mut ka Brit-

ish Parliament. “Hynrei ka jingiatai nia hapoh ka Khasi Parliament ka 6 long kaba i don akor bad shongkun shibun .” U la kynthoh bakitei ki rangbah bad ki khun samla kiba la wan poi sha ka Durbar ki kup ia ki sbor bad ryndia kiba iasyrlem bha ia ka jainkup jong ki Roman mynhyndai. Don artylli ki Rai kiba ktah jur ia ka Jaibynriew pyrthei kawei ka dei ka Rai khie khlieh bad pynpaw Iktiar ialade (Imperialism). Kawei pat ka bor bad ka jinglah saindur ia la ka jinglong kyrpang jong ka Jaidbynriew (Self determination). Baroh artylli kirn lah trei kam khlem ka Jingiatylli, ka Jingiaksoh kti bad ka Jinglong kawei jong ka Jaidbynriew. U Khasi hyndai uba la ih ha ka sain Hima kumba ialong lem ki Ri khraw-bor pyrthei, u la don la ka kyrdan trei kam ha la ri lum ne ri dkhar hapoh ki pud ki sam jong ka Hima jong u. Kiwei ki Jingkynthoh Uwei U saheb bishar na Shilot u Lindsay bad hadien pat uba kylla u saheb nongkhaii mawshun bad ka Ri Khasi shathie u la kynthoh ha ka kot ‘Lives of Lindsay’ vol. II Calcutta 1849 haba u la iashem bad ki nongkhaii na rilum ha Panduah hajan Bholaganj, kaba la jia ha u snem 1774 kumne- “During a few days of my residence at Pandua, I had the uncom- mon gratification of witnessing a caravansary arrived from the interior of the mountains bringing on their shoulders of the hills goods consisting of a coarest silk from the confines of China, fruits of various kinds but the great staple was the iron of excellent quality. The tribes in de- scending from rock to rock as represented in the Osca- md Malvina in the present instance the only descents was steps cut out in the precipices. The

burthens were carried by women in the baskets supported by a belt across the forehead, men walking by their side protecting them with arms. ...The young girls ... are handsome, not being allowed the use of beteinut until after their marriages. Haba katei ka Serampore Baptist Mission ka wad briew ban pynkylla Khasi ia ka Kotbah Khristan ha ka dak Bengali U William Carey u thoh ia ka shithi 1 1 tarik Nohprah, 1813 kumne:- “This week we have obtained a person to assist us in the transla- tion of the scriptures into the Khasi Language and 1 believe the only one in that whole nation who can read and write”. Kumjuh u Peaeree Carey u thoh ha ka kot kabna la jer kyrteng 19 “William Carey kumne” : “For such adequate pundit W. Carey somtimes sought for years. Kawei ka shithi pat ka ong “By 1817a few Khasi St. Mathew has been distributed to those Khasis living nearest to Bengal who could read the Bengali script”. Ha u snem 1817 khyndiat ki kitab St. Mathews kiba la shon la sam sha kito ki Khasi kiba shong ba sah kham shajan eh ia ka Bengal bad kiba lah ban pule ia ki dak Bengali. Utei u khasi uba tang ma u na ka Jaidbynriew (Khasee Na- tion) uba lah ban pule u la ia shem bad ka Serampore Mission bad nangne la mih ka jingpynkylla ia ka Gospel Mathews bad la shon la sam ia ka sha ki Khasi kiba nang pule Bangla ha u snem 1 8 1 7. 6. U SY1EM SNGAP U Syiem Sngap u sah kyrteng haduh mynta mynne kum u khla ka wait jong u khun Khasi uba ialeh thma khadduh ia ki phareng haduh ka snem 1839. Ka khana pateng shaphang jong u ka dang phriang ha ki phang ka Jakrem bad Raibah, Mawpud bad Nongnah bad kylleng sawdong ka Hima. Ka Jakrem ka dei ka nongbah barim ki syiem. Ia ka hima la synshar da ki ar iing syiem ki syiemlieh bad syiemiong. U Syiem Sngap u la mih pli ia u Syiem Ram Singh uba la iasoh bad u Syiem Tirot pyrshah ia ka Sorkar. Tad shu khyllait u Syiem Tirot, ka khana pateng ka ong, ki Maram ki la ialeh ia ka Sorkar. Ki tymmen ki kro ki ju iathuh bad ka thma kam shym kut ha ka por u Tirot Singh hynrei ka la neh 10 snem syndon, kata haduh u snem 1 839. Na ki dulir ngi shem ba ka Hima kam iasuk bad u Dor Syiemiong„u Syiem ka HimaNongstoin namar ki syiem hyndai teng teng kim lah lait khlem ialeh thma para ma ki-la shisha pat haba wan thorn u nongshun nabar, ki ju pyrshang iatylli kawei. Lajan baroh ki syiem Khasi ki iasnoh kawei bad u Tirot Singh lait tang u Syiem Sohra, u Syiem Nongwah uba kyrteng u Bolaram bad kiwei. Lada ki la iatylli kawei, ka history kan jin da shad da khongpong ym tang ka Ri Khasi hyrei kumjuh kajylla Assam. U Lt. Townshend uba peit ia ka Jylla sepngi na Mairang, u la pyntip ia u Agent ha Sohra ba kumba 1 00 ngut ki khla ka wait ka Hima Maram hapoh ka jingialam u Phanwum, ki la thang ia ka shnong Saphoo (imat ka Sohphoh) ha u Jylliew 1 834 kaba hap hapoh u Syiem Nongstoin. U Syiem Nongstoin u la phah kyrwoh sha u

Townshend ban phah jingiarap lane tan wan pynsuk. Ka daw ka thma ka long ba ki Maram kim treh ban siew ka baikliarwait ba la pynshet ka Sorkar. Ka la kham dier ka por ban tuklar ka Sorkar namar u Townshend u la dei ban kynjoh ktien shwa na Sohra. Kham hadien u Syiem Nongstoin u la panbor na ka Sorkar ba un leh ialehthma ia u Syiem Maram ( 1 ) U saheb bishar na Sohra u la phah ktien sha u Townshend ba un khot ia ka durbar ban wad ia ki sakhi satar na ki rangbah ka Hima Maram bad ban pynmih bad 41 pynshitom ia kitei ki ‘riewthma. Ym shym iohi shuh ia kiwei ki dulir shaphang ki jingjia babud hynrei imat kane ka la ialam sha ka thma Maram kaba U Syiem Sngap u la ialeh ia ka Sorkar. Ka Hima ka la pynpaw pyrthei ba dei tang maka napdeng kiwei pat ki Hima, ka bym pat liem ka wait ka stieh. (For 1 834 Deptt. Pol. Con. 4 Sep- tember No. 56) Ka Hima Maram kum kiwei pat ki Hima shathie, ka kynthup lai bynta-ka rilum, ka riwar, bad ka rithem Shi lot. Kawei ka daw jong ka thma ka long ba ka Sorkar, ka la knieh noh ia ka khajna jong ka Hima dkhar ha ki bynta ka Puran, Saspur, Kadir bad Konah haneng Sunamganj kiba hap hapoh ka Hima. Ki khana pateng ruh ki kynpham ba ka thma ka khie namar ka Sorkar ka la knieh noh ia ka Hima dkhar u Syiem. U Syiem Sngap u la lum lang ia ki khla ka wait, ki khyndai bah ryntieh, ki ‘rang kiengwait kiengstieh bad u la khreh thma. Ka jingialeh bashyrkhei ka la khie sha ki thain Rangthong bad ka jingialeh bakhadduh ka dei ha Raibah. Ki khla ka wait ki la lah

ban bat slem ia ka Rangthong, Jakrem, Mar Shillong hynrei hadien ka Sorkar ka la lap lynti ba leit thorn ia kitei ki kut da ka jingiarap kiwei ki briew. Ha Rangthong shibun ki shipai ki la kyllon. Ha ka por u Tirot ngi iohsngew shaphang ki kongbah thma kum u Lorshon, u Khein Kongor, u Nishan, u Kyllup bad kiwei . Ki Maram ruh ha ka thma ki la pynmih ruh ia ki’ riewthma ba radbah kum u Tep Shiak, u Moit Kliaw bad u Phan Maram kiba la bat bun snem ia ka kut ha Nongnah. Ki Khasi ki la siat da ki khnam ding bad khnam bih. Kawei pat ka rukom ialeh thma ka long da kaba ki teh da ki jyrmi jyrteh ia ki maw ha ki sharing lum bad ynda ki shipai ki la kiew ia ki thiep bah, ki ‘riewthma ki la pom ia ki jyrmi bad ki maw ki la tyllun halor ka lynti bad khang kdong ia ki shipai lane tylliat syndon ia u briew. Don ki kynthei ‘ riewshlur kiba la iasnoh lang bad ki rangbah. Ngi la iohsngew ia ka Phan Nonglait ha ka por u Tirot. Ha ka snem 1836- 38 pat ngi iohsngew ia ka Lar, ka Dap kynthei bad ka nongswar bastad buit kaba la shang kylleng ban syntiat ia ka Sorkar shaduh Balat bad shaduh ri dkhar bad ka ia phah jingtip babiang sha u Syiem 42 bad ki Bakhraw ka Hima biang biang ia ka jingwan ki shipai, ki lynti ki syngkien ba ki iaid, ka kynhun jong ki, ki atiar bad kiwei, Ha ka snem 1 836, ka Sorkar ka la pyndonkam da u phud u pyrton jong ka Sylhet Light Infantry hadien ba ka jingialeh ka la neh palat shisnem. La pynpoi da ki shipai Gurkha kiba la ialeh tyngeh ban dakhol ia ki kut ‘riewthma Ha kawei na kine ki thma, u saheb (Major) Lister uba la wallam ia ka kynhun, u la shah siat khnam:

une u saheb mynwei u la mynsaw na u khnam ha ka snem 1829 ha ka thma Nongkhlaw. La iathuh ba kawei ka kynhun hadien kawei pat, ki la wan ban pyndem hynrei ka thma ka la neh haduh u snem 1839. Ka jingialeh bajur ka la neh baroh shisnem ha ka 1837. Ha u bnai Iaiong bad Jymmang 1 838, u Lat rangbah ka Ri India u la hukum ia ka bor sorkar jong ka jylla ban wad bniah ia ka daw jong kane ka jmgkhih thma. La wallam ka kynhun shipai bakham khlain hapoh u Captain W.J. Bennet ban dakhol ia ka kut ha uwei u kynjang lum hynrei ki ‘riewthma ki la pynher krad ia ki shipai. Kham hadien u Bennet u la phah da u dobsasia (interpreter) ban khot ia ki ‘riewthma ban wan iasuk bad u la khroh ruh ba kin wan pyndem la ki wait ki stieh ha khmat jong u, hynrei ki riewthma ki la kylla ktien da ka sur bakhor bad ki la khot ia ki shipai ba kit ia ki suloi ktang ban wan thorn ia ki bad nangta ban kit ban bah ia ki kat shaba ki mon. Ki shipai ki la ther bad ki riewthma hadien ki la ia phet noh. (1) La iathuh ba kita ki kut ba la sher ha ki sharing ka Nongnah, ha ki phang Nongkdait, Thiep Bamon bad Mawtajem, ki long ki bym lab pynkhih da ki snem. Haduh mynta ka don ka riat ba ki khot ‘Ka riat pynhap briew’ ha ka por ba ki la pynhap kai ia ki shipai sha riat. Bun na ki briew baiap, la tep ha u stong bym don por ban tih thliew. Ki ‘riewthma ki la sher kut da ki maw bajrong bah, kiba la ker baroh sawdong bad la pynap kharai baroh sawdong ka kut. Harum ka kut pat ki la tih thliew ba la siang da ka khyndew stang ba sop u stong (1) For 1838 Dept. Pol. Con 9 May 4

43 bad mar iapoi ki shipai, ki la Hat bad shitom na ki siej banep shier ba la pynap Ipa hapoh kata ka thliew. Ha kaba kut, ka Sorkar ka la khroh da ki syiem Mylliem, u Syiem Bor Manik bad u Shan Manik ban leit tem bad imat kine ki la pynpoi sha ka iasuk iasain. Kavvei ka khana ka ong ba la thong da uwei u briew na Balat ban leit thorn ia ka kut ka bym shym pynap pahara bha da ki briew. Ki briew ki leit ia wan ban pyndap bam bad atiar na kata ka kut. Ki ‘riewthma pat ki la ap pahara ia ki arkut pyrshah ia u nongshun. Haduh ka snem 1839, la don ka jingpyniap briew ia ki briew Sorkar bad shipai kiba leit ba wan bad ka Sorkar ka la ialeh tyngeh ban khang ia ki iew ki hat, ki lynti syngkien, ka rep ka riang ban pyniap thngan bad pynbun ka kynhun shipai ha kitei ki thain. (2) Hadien ba la jop ia ka Nongnah, u syiem u la phet sha Raibah. Dei ha Raibah ba la ioh kem ia u. U lyoh u kah dum bad u Syiem Sngap u la ong, “La khyllem ki rangkieng wait: Ko ki shnong Nongnah bad Mawpud, Raibah bad Kyniong, Rangthong bad Jakrem phi la sei la ki khun shynrang, ki riewshlur satar hynrei ki la khyllait noh, nga ruh nga la suk ka iap ban ia ka im”. La iathuh ba uwei u khynnah samla ha ka ia bakut, u la pyrshang ban leit thang ia ka dara shipai sha thain Umkhniang ha ka por shiteng synnia hamar ba ki shipai ki dang iohthiah bad u la pyrshang ban pynmih ding da kaba kyrshut ia ki mawshamok. Hynrei hadien ki shipai ki la iohsngew bad ki la mih shabar. Ki la shem ia u bad ki la siat na ki kjat jong u. Kine ki long ki khana

kiba pynpaw haduh katno u Khasi hyndai u long uba shlur bad u bym riej. Haba la jop ia u Sngap, u Lister u la pynneh ia u kum u Syiem bad um shym pynshitom ban ring koidi ia u. U la kular ban map ia kiwei ki ‘riewthma. U la buh pynap ia ki shipai ha ka Hima haduh ba ka thma kan da jem bha. Hynrei u SyierCSngap u dei ban siew baikliar wait namar ka jingjulor bad ka jinglut ka Sorkar ha kaba (2) For 1839 Dept. Pol. Con. 9 Feb. No. 8 44 wallam shipai. U don uwei u kur ne uba ha iing jong u Syiem uba kyrteng u Jibor uba la shah ring kum u bai kliarwait. Nyngkong ki la pyrkhat ban ialam ia u sha Sohra ban shong ban sah hajan u Lister hynrei hadien ki la rai pat ban ialam ia u sha Mylliem ban shong ban sah bad u Shan Manik. U Lister u la khlei la ka juban ban pyllait noh ia ki koidi thma ba la set ha Sohra lada jia bym lap sabut ei ei ba ki la iadon kti ha ki kam pyniap briew. (1) Ki Syiem Mylliem ki la iakubur ban pynlum ia u bai kliar wait ban siew ia ka Sorkar. Baroh ki thma ki khie namar ba don ka daw. Ha kane ka thma, u Syiem um shym khih bieit khlem ka nia babiang bad bunsien u Syiem u la kylli pyrthew: “Mano ba pynkhih thma shwa, mangi ne ka Sorkar? Mano ba leit lushia nyngkong ia ka Hima dkhar jong ngi? Lada phi kwah iasuk khie leit ong ia ka Sorkar ba kan iehnoh shisyndon bad kan pynphai ia ka Hima dkhar jongngi. Balei phi knieh ia ka khajna jong ngi khlem da sngewthuh shwa bad ngi u Trai?” Kaba ktah eh ha kane ka khana kajong ka jingpynkhlad ia u

Jibor kum u nongsah bynda sha Mylliem. U nonglamktien ka hima u la wan jngoh hadien ia u Jibor ha Mylliem bad khlem lah set shuh ia ki umat, u la kren kumne: “ Khublei kong Syiem, u khlur ka hima Maram. Phin iai imjunom kum u ‘tiew lasubon baiai suhsieng. Kong Syiem ngi kwah dik dik ngi dwai ngi phirat ba kin mih ki khlur phymai ha ka suin bneng ka Hima Maram bad ka Ri Khasi, kynthei bad shynrang kiba ieit ia la ka Jaidbynriew”. U Jibor u jubab, “ nga la tymmen bad ngam sngew lah shan stem shuh. Ngi la liem da ka wait, hynrei ka don kawei pat ka atiar kaba long ka jingshemphang, ka khlieh baproh bad ka jingstad. Wat pynluin, khie sei ia ki radbah bad ki khlieh ban kyntitw pat ia ka Hima”. U nonglamktien u kren dukha: ‘Haba kum ma phi, phi la ran, ngin sei khlieh pat naei? Hooid ngin pyrshang. Lada kam jia mynta, lehse kan urlong ha ki spah snem hadien ba ngin iohi pat ia (1) Deptt. For. Pol con 1839 Ref. No 62 Pol 1839 Con 23.No 73& 74 45 ka Hima Maram bad Ri Khasi ba la kha thymmai ha ka burom bad ka iktiar bakhraw’. U Jibor ha ka jingsngew bynniaw u la kyang khadduh-”Khublei jynduh Hima Maram. Ka burom bad ka bor jong pha ka la wai. Khublei ko ki ‘riewradbah ka nia ka buit, khublei ko ki ‘riewradbah ka wait ka stieh, nga la theh la ka jingim la ka buit ka bor la met bad mynsiem ban pynim ia pha, hynrei nga la liem bad la rem. Ah Blei Trai Kynrad to ri to da ma Me ban ym iaid sakma ki samla kynthei

bad shynrang ban pynjngut ia ka kyrteng jong ka Jaidbynriew. Khublei namar jong pha, ngan sah bynda ha shnong ki briew. Khublei, Khublei”. Ngi ngeit skhem ba ki briew ki la iohi jngai ia ki jingsniew babun bad kiwei ki jingteh jingkhum da ka jingwan ka jingkylla synshar, kumta ki la neh slem ha ka thma. Ki iohi ia ki jingsniew kiba ktah ia ka longiing longsem, long shnong longthaw bad long hima sima, kiba ktah ruh ia ka longlang bad ka longbriew. Kine ki jingsniew ki la paw ngut nget naduh ka por u Tirot haba ki phareng ki la pyrshang ban knieh ia ki lew bad Hima dkhar kiba la kyrshan ia ki baroh shikatta. Ki la sngewsheptieng ba ki riti kin pra ha ki ‘dew' kynting. Ki la sheptieng ba ka kynthei ka khynnah kan iaid laitllan bad ba u kni u kpa un duh ei la ka bor. Ki la sheptieng ruh ban dull noh la ka tynrai ha ka iing ka sem, ka bam ka dih, ka riam ka beit, ka put ka tern, ka trei ka ktah, ka kamai kajih bad ter ter. Ka jingkylla ban pynbha bad tei pat ia ka Ri ka dei ban sdang hi napoh rympei bad ym dei ban wan na bar, namar tang bakla khyndiat ki briew ki lah ban ioh tang ka rongphong hynrei kim ioh ia ka mynsiem, ka jingshemphang, ka jingtbit tynrai bad jingtrei shitom jong ki briew kiba la shai bad kiba la stad bunshah ia ki Khasi. Ki syiem ki la iohi ia ki bad ki jingjia ki la wan urlong. 46 7. USYIEM BORSINGH BAD U RI.ION SINGH KA HIM a nongkhlaw Hadien ba u Tirot Singh u la khlad noh ha Dacca, ka Hima

Nongkhlaw ka la hap ha ki bun ki jingkylla. Ha ka snem 1834 ka Hima ka la pynskhem ia u Syiem Rijon Singh ban hiar pateng ia u Syiem Tirot. U Rijon u long uba wan dur bha bad u dang dap tang 1 3 ne 1 4 snem ka karta. U lah ban kren, pule bad thoh ia ka ktien Bengali. Kane ka por ka la sdang ban wallam ia ka jingsuk hadien ka thma ba la neh slem. Bun ki briew kiba la phet thma sha krem sha kroh ki la wanphai sha la ki shnong. Ki ri them Assam ruh ki la shong suk pat. U F. Jenkins Agent jong u Governor General u la shem ba ki Khasi kim duna ha ka khlieh bad ka jingshemphang. Ka Ri Khasi ka donnam eh namar ka shun ka iaid khaii bha shaduh ka Ri Bengal. Ki raiot ha Bordwar kim ju ujor ban sah hapoh u syiem Khasi. Ha ka 29 tarik Lber 1 834(1 ) la kyntiew khet ia u Syiem Rijon. Ha ka por ba la thung syiem ia u, k& kynhun ki phareng hapoh u Captain Lister bad u Lt. Inglis ka la wan ban pynbiang ia ki kam bad ka jingiasoi soskular hapdeng ka Hima Nongkhlaw bad ka Sorkar phareng. Ki Myntri ka Hima ki long u Rumon (na Nongkhlaw), u Ram (na Mairang), u Tep (na Bynther), u Phan (na Mawnai) bad u Mit (na Nongrmai). Kat kum ka riti, khlem da biang ki Myntri, ym long ban thung Syiem. Haba ym lah ban ioh ia u pyrsa trai jong u Syiem nongsynshar uba la khlad noh, ki Myntri ki pyrkhat bad ki ia rai ia uno uno don hok ban long syiem na ka iing syiem. Hynrei lada ki Myntri kim iahap kawei, dei ban rah ia ka kam sha ki Sordar ka Hima. U Rijon, u pyrsa trai u Tirot u don hok ban long syiem hynrei u dang khunlung eh, kumta la jied ia u Tirot (1826). Hynrei ia u Tirot ruh la thung tang kum u nongpynsynshar na ka bynta u Rijon

uba dang dap san snem ha u snem 1 826. (1) For. 1834. Deptt. Pol. Con 22 May 80 47 U Syiem Rijon u la synshar katto katne snem. Hynrei kham hadien u la ngam ha ka kiad, u la leh lut phut, u la hap ruh hapoh ka jingpyniaid ki muktiar Bengalee bad u la sah kham bun na ka por ha Gauhati, ym dei ha Bordwar ne Nongkhlaw ki nongbah ka hima la jong. U la kylla dap ram bad kumta khlem banse shuh, u la die ia la ka khet ha ka snem 1 848 ha u Syiem Jidor ryngkat bad ka jingiakut ba un ioh baibam katba dang long syiem ma u. Mynshuwa kane, ngi shem ba la pynkynriah la ka Borduwar na ka jingsymhar u Rijon namar um lah shuh ban siew khajna thikna sha ka Sorkar. U Syiem Jidor naduh ba u la shimti, u la synshar bha. Ula pynbeit bad pynryntih ia la ka Hima, pynroi ia ka rep ka riang, ka khaii ka pateng, ka bishar ka khadar hadien ba ka Hima ka la shah saja na ka bynta ka thma bad ka jingumsnam kaba neh slem. U la shimti pat ia ka Bordwar bad u la siew beit ia ka khajna. Ki sahep Sorkar ki kynthoh ba u long u syiem uba nep bad shemphang bha. Na ka bynta ban iaid beit ka kam, u Syiem u la thung ia la u pyrsa ksiew, u Borsingh kum u Syiem khynnah uba la iatrei lang hapoh ka Hima ha ka por ba eh tam. U Syiem Jidor u la pynbna ha u Nohprah 9 tank, 1852 ba u Borsingh un mih bteng ia u kum u Syiem hadien ka jingiap jong u. Ia kane la pynskhem ha khmat ka Kashari bah ha Sohra. U Jidor u la aiti ha u Bor Singh ia ka khor ka khriam, ki paila ka ksair bad ka riam syiem kum u nongioh pateng bad u la aiti ruh ia

ki syiem kynthei baroh ban sumar ma u. U Jidor u la khlad noh ha u Kylla Lyngkot 1 9, 1 856 bad u Bor Singh u la pyndep ia ka niam iap baroh jong u Syiem Jidor. Hynrei tang shipor hadien la mih ka jingpyrshah ia ka long syiem bad ka jingiapait hapdeng ki Myntri bad ki Sordar. U Sahep bishar na Sohra, C.K. Hudson u la leit sha Mairang ha u Iaiong 1856 ban twad ia kajingmut ki rangbah ka Hima, U la shem lajan baroh ki Myntri kiba la kyntiew khet ia u Rijon ha ka 1 834 ki la iap noh lait sa tang lai ngut bad uwei u myntri thymmai ba la thung u Syiem Jidor. Ar ki Myntri bad khambun ki Sordar ka Hima kiba la wan iashem ia u sahep, ki la mon ia u Rijon ban, shimti 48 ia ka kam; khyndiat kiwei pat ki la jied ia u Bor Singh. Lajan baroh ki syiem Khasi ki iasnoh kawei bad u Tirot Singh lait tang u Syiem Sohra, u Syiem Nongwah uba kyrteng u Bolaram bad kiwei. Lada ki la iatylli kawei, ka history kan jin da shad da khongpong ym tang ka Ri Khasi hyrei kumjuh kajylla Assam. U Lt. Townshend uba peit ia ka Jylla sepngi na Mairang, u la pyntip ia u Agent ha Sohra ba kumba 1 00 ngut ki khla ka wait ka Hima Maram hapoh ka jingialam u Phanwum, ki la thang ia ka shnong Saphoo (imat ka Sohphoh) ha u Jylliew 1 834 kaba hap hapoh u Syiem Nongstoin. U Syiem Nongstoin u la phah kyrwoh sha u

Townshend ban phah jingiarap lane tan wan pynsuk. Ka daw ka thma ka long ba ki Maram kim treh ban siew ka baikliarwait ba la pynshet ka Sorkar. Ka la kham dier ka por ban tuklar ka Sorkar namar u Townshend u la dei ban kynjoh ktien shwa na Sohra. Kham hadien u Syiem Nongstoin u la panbor na ka Sorkar ba un leh ialehthma ia u Syiem Maram ( 1 ) U saheb bishar na Sohra u la phah ktien sha u Townshend ba un khot ia ka durbar ban wad ia ki sakhi satar na ki rangbah ka Hima Maram bad ban pynmih bad 41 pynshitom ia kitei ki ‘riewthma. Ym shym iohi shuh ia kiwei ki dulir shaphang ki jingjia babud hynrei imat kane ka la ialam sha ka thma Maram kaba U Syiem Sngap u la ialeh ia ka Sorkar. Ka Hima ka la pynpaw pyrthei ba dei tang maka napdeng kiwei pat ki Hima, ka bym pat liem ka wait ka stieh. (For 1 834 Deptt. Pol. Con. 4 Sep- tember No. 56) Ka Hima Maram kum kiwei pat ki Hima shathie, ka kynthup lai bynta-ka rilum, ka riwar, bad ka rithem Shi lot. Kawei ka daw jong ka thma ka long ba ka Sorkar, ka la knieh noh ia ka khajna jong ka Hima dkhar ha ki bynta ka Puran, Saspur, Kadir bad Konah haneng Sunamganj kiba hap hapoh ka Hima. Ki khana pateng ruh ki kynpham ba ka thma ka khie namar ka Sorkar ka la knieh noh ia ka Hima dkhar u Syiem. U Syiem Sngap u la lum lang ia ki khla ka wait, ki khyndai bah ryntieh, ki ‘rang kiengwait kiengstieh bad u la khreh thma. Ka jingialeh bashyrkhei ka la khie sha ki thain Rangthong bad ka jingialeh bakhadduh ka dei ha Raibah. Ki khla ka wait ki la lah

ban bat slem ia ka Rangthong, Jakrem, Mar Shillong hynrei hadien ka Sorkar ka la lap lynti ba leit thorn ia kitei ki kut da ka jingiarap kiwei ki briew. Ha Rangthong shibun ki shipai ki la kyllon. Ha ka por u Tirot ngi iohsngew shaphang ki kongbah thma kum u Lorshon, u Khein Kongor, u Nishan, u Kyllup bad kiwei . Ki Maram ruh ha ka thma ki la pynmih ruh ia ki’ riewthma ba radbah kum u Tep Shiak, u Moit Kliaw bad u Phan Maram kiba la bat bun snem ia ka kut ha Nongnah. Ki Khasi ki la siat da ki khnam ding bad khnam bih. Kawei pat ka rukom ialeh thma ka long da kaba ki teh da ki jyrmi jyrteh ia ki maw ha ki sharing lum bad ynda ki shipai ki la kiew ia ki thiep bah, ki ‘riewthma ki la pom ia ki jyrmi bad ki maw ki la tyllun halor ka lynti bad khang kdong ia ki shipai lane tylliat syndon ia u briew. Don ki kynthei ‘ riewshlur kiba la iasnoh lang bad ki rangbah. Ngi la iohsngew ia ka Phan Nonglait ha ka por u Tirot. Ha ka snem 1836- 38 pat ngi iohsngew ia ka Lar, ka Dap kynthei bad ka nongswar bastad buit kaba la shang kylleng ban syntiat ia ka Sorkar shaduh Balat bad shaduh ri dkhar bad ka ia phah jingtip babiang sha u Syiem 42 bad ki Bakhraw ka Hima biang biang ia ka jingwan ki shipai, ki lynti ki syngkien ba ki iaid, ka kynhun jong ki, ki atiar bad kiwei, Ha ka snem 1 836, ka Sorkar ka la pyndonkam da u phud u pyrton jong ka Sylhet Light Infantry hadien ba ka jingialeh ka la neh palat shisnem. La pynpoi da ki shipai Gurkha kiba la ialeh tyngeh ban dakhol ia ki kut ‘riewthma Ha kawei na kine ki thma, u saheb (Major) Lister uba la wallam ia ka kynhun, u la shah siat khnam:

une u saheb mynwei u la mynsaw na u khnam ha ka snem 1829 ha ka thma Nongkhlaw. La iathuh ba kawei ka kynhun hadien kawei pat, ki la wan ban pyndem hynrei ka thma ka la neh haduh u snem 1839. Ka jingialeh bajur ka la neh baroh shisnem ha ka 1837. Ha u bnai Iaiong bad Jymmang 1 838, u Lat rangbah ka Ri India u la hukum ia ka bor sorkar jong ka jylla ban wad bniah ia ka daw jong kane ka jmgkhih thma. La wallam ka kynhun shipai bakham khlain hapoh u Captain W.J. Bennet ban dakhol ia ka kut ha uwei u kynjang lum hynrei ki ‘riewthma ki la pynher krad ia ki shipai. Kham hadien u Bennet u la phah da u dobsasia (interpreter) ban khot ia ki ‘riewthma ban wan iasuk bad u la khroh ruh ba kin wan pyndem la ki wait ki stieh ha khmat jong u, hynrei ki riewthma ki la kylla ktien da ka sur bakhor bad ki la khot ia ki shipai ba kit ia ki suloi ktang ban wan thorn ia ki bad nangta ban kit ban bah ia ki kat shaba ki mon. Ki shipai ki la ther bad ki riewthma hadien ki la ia phet noh. (1) La iathuh ba kita ki kut ba la sher ha ki sharing ka Nongnah, ha ki phang Nongkdait, Thiep Bamon bad Mawtajem, ki long ki bym lab pynkhih da ki snem. Haduh mynta ka don ka riat ba ki khot ‘Ka riat pynhap briew’ ha ka por ba ki la pynhap kai ia ki shipai sha riat. Bun na ki briew baiap, la tep ha u stong bym don por ban tih thliew. Ki ‘riewthma ki la sher kut da ki maw bajrong bah, kiba la ker baroh sawdong bad la pynap kharai baroh sawdong ka kut. Harum ka kut pat ki la tih thliew ba la siang da ka khyndew stang ba sop u stong (1) For 1838 Dept. Pol. Con 9 May 4

43 bad mar iapoi ki shipai, ki la Hat bad shitom na ki siej banep shier ba la pynap Ipa hapoh kata ka thliew. Ha kaba kut, ka Sorkar ka la khroh da ki syiem Mylliem, u Syiem Bor Manik bad u Shan Manik ban leit tem bad imat kine ki la pynpoi sha ka iasuk iasain. Kavvei ka khana ka ong ba la thong da uwei u briew na Balat ban leit thorn ia ka kut ka bym shym pynap pahara bha da ki briew. Ki briew ki leit ia wan ban pyndap bam bad atiar na kata ka kut. Ki ‘riewthma pat ki la ap pahara ia ki arkut pyrshah ia u nongshun. Haduh ka snem 1839, la don ka jingpyniap briew ia ki briew Sorkar bad shipai kiba leit ba wan bad ka Sorkar ka la ialeh tyngeh ban khang ia ki iew ki hat, ki lynti syngkien, ka rep ka riang ban pyniap thngan bad pynbun ka kynhun shipai ha kitei ki thain. (2) Hadien ba la jop ia ka Nongnah, u syiem u la phet sha Raibah. Dei ha Raibah ba la ioh kem ia u. U lyoh u kah dum bad u Syiem Sngap u la ong, “La khyllem ki rangkieng wait: Ko ki shnong Nongnah bad Mawpud, Raibah bad Kyniong, Rangthong bad Jakrem phi la sei la ki khun shynrang, ki riewshlur satar hynrei ki la khyllait noh, nga ruh nga la suk ka iap ban ia ka im”. La iathuh ba uwei u khynnah samla ha ka ia bakut, u la pyrshang ban leit thang ia ka dara shipai sha thain Umkhniang ha ka por shiteng synnia hamar ba ki shipai ki dang iohthiah bad u la pyrshang ban pynmih ding da kaba kyrshut ia ki mawshamok. Hynrei hadien ki shipai ki la iohsngew bad ki la mih shabar. Ki la shem ia u bad ki la siat na ki kjat jong u. Kine ki long ki khana

kiba pynpaw haduh katno u Khasi hyndai u long uba shlur bad u bym riej. Haba la jop ia u Sngap, u Lister u la pynneh ia u kum u Syiem bad um shym pynshitom ban ring koidi ia u. U la kular ban map ia kiwei ki ‘riewthma. U la buh pynap ia ki shipai ha ka Hima haduh ba ka thma kan da jem bha. Hynrei u SyierCSngap u dei ban siew baikliar wait namar ka jingjulor bad ka jinglut ka Sorkar ha kaba (2) For 1839 Dept. Pol. Con. 9 Feb. No. 8 44 wallam shipai. U don uwei u kur ne uba ha iing jong u Syiem uba kyrteng u Jibor uba la shah ring kum u bai kliarwait. Nyngkong ki la pyrkhat ban ialam ia u sha Sohra ban shong ban sah hajan u Lister hynrei hadien ki la rai pat ban ialam ia u sha Mylliem ban shong ban sah bad u Shan Manik. U Lister u la khlei la ka juban ban pyllait noh ia ki koidi thma ba la set ha Sohra lada jia bym lap sabut ei ei ba ki la iadon kti ha ki kam pyniap briew. (1) Ki Syiem Mylliem ki la iakubur ban pynlum ia u bai kliar wait ban siew ia ka Sorkar. Baroh ki thma ki khie namar ba don ka daw. Ha kane ka thma, u Syiem um shym khih bieit khlem ka nia babiang bad bunsien u Syiem u la kylli pyrthew: “Mano ba pynkhih thma shwa, mangi ne ka Sorkar? Mano ba leit lushia nyngkong ia ka Hima dkhar jong ngi? Lada phi kwah iasuk khie leit ong ia ka Sorkar ba kan iehnoh shisyndon bad kan pynphai ia ka Hima dkhar jongngi. Balei phi knieh ia ka khajna jong ngi khlem da sngewthuh shwa bad ngi u Trai?” Kaba ktah eh ha kane ka khana kajong ka jingpynkhlad ia u

Jibor kum u nongsah bynda sha Mylliem. U nonglamktien ka hima u la wan jngoh hadien ia u Jibor ha Mylliem bad khlem lah set shuh ia ki umat, u la kren kumne: “ Khublei kong Syiem, u khlur ka hima Maram. Phin iai imjunom kum u ‘tiew lasubon baiai suhsieng. Kong Syiem ngi kwah dik dik ngi dwai ngi phirat ba kin mih ki khlur phymai ha ka suin bneng ka Hima Maram bad ka Ri Khasi, kynthei bad shynrang kiba ieit ia la ka Jaidbynriew”. U Jibor u jubab, “ nga la tymmen bad ngam sngew lah shan stem shuh. Ngi la liem da ka wait, hynrei ka don kawei pat ka atiar kaba long ka jingshemphang, ka khlieh baproh bad ka jingstad. Wat pynluin, khie sei ia ki radbah bad ki khlieh ban kyntitw pat ia ka Hima”. U nonglamktien u kren dukha: ‘Haba kum ma phi, phi la ran, ngin sei khlieh pat naei? Hooid ngin pyrshang. Lada kam jia mynta, lehse kan urlong ha ki spah snem hadien ba ngin iohi pat ia (1) Deptt. For. Pol con 1839 Ref. No 62 Pol 1839 Con 23.No 73& 74 45 ka Hima Maram bad Ri Khasi ba la kha thymmai ha ka burom bad ka iktiar bakhraw’. U Jibor ha ka jingsngew bynniaw u la kyang khadduh-”Khublei jynduh Hima Maram. Ka burom bad ka bor jong pha ka la wai. Khublei ko ki ‘riewradbah ka nia ka buit, khublei ko ki ‘riewradbah ka wait ka stieh, nga la theh la ka jingim la ka buit ka bor la met bad mynsiem ban pynim ia pha, hynrei nga la liem bad la rem. Ah Blei Trai Kynrad to ri to da ma Me ban ym iaid sakma ki samla kynthei

bad shynrang ban pynjngut ia ka kyrteng jong ka Jaidbynriew. Khublei namar jong pha, ngan sah bynda ha shnong ki briew. Khublei, Khublei”. Ngi ngeit skhem ba ki briew ki la iohi jngai ia ki jingsniew babun bad kiwei ki jingteh jingkhum da ka jingwan ka jingkylla synshar, kumta ki la neh slem ha ka thma. Ki iohi ia ki jingsniew kiba ktah ia ka longiing longsem, long shnong longthaw bad long hima sima, kiba ktah ruh ia ka longlang bad ka longbriew. Kine ki jingsniew ki la paw ngut nget naduh ka por u Tirot haba ki phareng ki la pyrshang ban knieh ia ki lew bad Hima dkhar kiba la kyrshan ia ki baroh shikatta. Ki la sngewsheptieng ba ki riti kin pra ha ki ‘dew' kynting. Ki la sheptieng ba ka kynthei ka khynnah kan iaid laitllan bad ba u kni u kpa un duh ei la ka bor. Ki la sheptieng ruh ban dull noh la ka tynrai ha ka iing ka sem, ka bam ka dih, ka riam ka beit, ka put ka tern, ka trei ka ktah, ka kamai kajih bad ter ter. Ka jingkylla ban pynbha bad tei pat ia ka Ri ka dei ban sdang hi napoh rympei bad ym dei ban wan na bar, namar tang bakla khyndiat ki briew ki lah ban ioh tang ka rongphong hynrei kim ioh ia ka mynsiem, ka jingshemphang, ka jingtbit tynrai bad jingtrei shitom jong ki briew kiba la shai bad kiba la stad bunshah ia ki Khasi. Ki syiem ki la iohi ia ki bad ki jingjia ki la wan urlong. 46 7. USYIEM BORSINGH BAD U RI.ION SINGH KA HIM a nongkhlaw Hadien ba u Tirot Singh u la khlad noh ha Dacca, ka Hima

Nongkhlaw ka la hap ha ki bun ki jingkylla. Ha ka snem 1834 ka Hima ka la pynskhem ia u Syiem Rijon Singh ban hiar pateng ia u Syiem Tirot. U Rijon u long uba wan dur bha bad u dang dap tang 1 3 ne 1 4 snem ka karta. U lah ban kren, pule bad thoh ia ka ktien Bengali. Kane ka por ka la sdang ban wallam ia ka jingsuk hadien ka thma ba la neh slem. Bun ki briew kiba la phet thma sha krem sha kroh ki la wanphai sha la ki shnong. Ki ri them Assam ruh ki la shong suk pat. U F. Jenkins Agent jong u Governor General u la shem ba ki Khasi kim duna ha ka khlieh bad ka jingshemphang. Ka Ri Khasi ka donnam eh namar ka shun ka iaid khaii bha shaduh ka Ri Bengal. Ki raiot ha Bordwar kim ju ujor ban sah hapoh u syiem Khasi. Ha ka 29 tarik Lber 1 834(1 ) la kyntiew khet ia u Syiem Rijon. Ha ka por ba la thung syiem ia u, k& kynhun ki phareng hapoh u Captain Lister bad u Lt. Inglis ka la wan ban pynbiang ia ki kam bad ka jingiasoi soskular hapdeng ka Hima Nongkhlaw bad ka Sorkar phareng. Ki Myntri ka Hima ki long u Rumon (na Nongkhlaw), u Ram (na Mairang), u Tep (na Bynther), u Phan (na Mawnai) bad u Mit (na Nongrmai). Kat kum ka riti, khlem da biang ki Myntri, ym long ban thung Syiem. Haba ym lah ban ioh ia u pyrsa trai jong u Syiem nongsynshar uba la khlad noh, ki Myntri ki pyrkhat bad ki ia rai ia uno uno don hok ban long syiem na ka iing syiem. Hynrei lada ki Myntri kim iahap kawei, dei ban rah ia ka kam sha ki Sordar ka Hima. U Rijon, u pyrsa trai u Tirot u don hok ban long syiem hynrei u dang khunlung eh, kumta la jied ia u Tirot (1826). Hynrei ia u Tirot ruh la thung tang kum u nongpynsynshar na ka bynta u Rijon

uba dang dap san snem ha u snem 1 826. (1) For. 1834. Deptt. Pol. Con 22 May 80 47 U Syiem Rijon u la synshar katto katne snem. Hynrei kham hadien u la ngam ha ka kiad, u la leh lut phut, u la hap ruh hapoh ka jingpyniaid ki muktiar Bengalee bad u la sah kham bun na ka por ha Gauhati, ym dei ha Bordwar ne Nongkhlaw ki nongbah ka hima la jong. U la kylla dap ram bad kumta khlem banse shuh, u la die ia la ka khet ha ka snem 1 848 ha u Syiem Jidor ryngkat bad ka jingiakut ba un ioh baibam katba dang long syiem ma u. Mynshuwa kane, ngi shem ba la pynkynriah la ka Borduwar na ka jingsymhar u Rijon namar um lah shuh ban siew khajna thikna sha ka Sorkar. U Syiem Jidor naduh ba u la shimti, u la synshar bha. Ula pynbeit bad pynryntih ia la ka Hima, pynroi ia ka rep ka riang, ka khaii ka pateng, ka bishar ka khadar hadien ba ka Hima ka la shah saja na ka bynta ka thma bad ka jingumsnam kaba neh slem. U la shimti pat ia ka Bordwar bad u la siew beit ia ka khajna. Ki sahep Sorkar ki kynthoh ba u long u syiem uba nep bad shemphang bha. Na ka bynta ban iaid beit ka kam, u Syiem u la thung ia la u pyrsa ksiew, u Borsingh kum u Syiem khynnah uba la iatrei lang hapoh ka Hima ha ka por ba eh tam. U Syiem Jidor u la pynbna ha u Nohprah 9 tank, 1852 ba u Borsingh un mih bteng ia u kum u Syiem hadien ka jingiap jong u. Ia kane la pynskhem ha khmat ka Kashari bah ha Sohra. U Jidor u la aiti ha u Bor Singh ia ka khor ka khriam, ki paila ka ksair bad ka riam syiem kum u nongioh pateng bad u la aiti ruh ia

ki syiem kynthei baroh ban sumar ma u. U Jidor u la khlad noh ha u Kylla Lyngkot 1 9, 1 856 bad u Bor Singh u la pyndep ia ka niam iap baroh jong u Syiem Jidor. Hynrei tang shipor hadien la mih ka jingpyrshah ia ka long syiem bad ka jingiapait hapdeng ki Myntri bad ki Sordar. U Sahep bishar na Sohra, C.K. Hudson u la leit sha Mairang ha u Iaiong 1856 ban twad ia kajingmut ki rangbah ka Hima, U la shem lajan baroh ki Myntri kiba la kyntiew khet ia u Rijon ha ka 1 834 ki la iap noh lait sa tang lai ngut bad uwei u myntri thymmai ba la thung u Syiem Jidor. Ar ki Myntri bad khambun ki Sordar ka Hima kiba la wan iashem ia u sahep, ki la mon ia u Rijon ban, shimti 48 ia ka kam; khyndiat kiwei pat ki la jied ia u Bor Singh. U Hudson uba la poi ha ka khim, u la tyrwa beit ban phiah noh ia kane ka Hima v ar bynta bad ba ka wah Burpanee kan long u pud hapdeng ka bhah u Rijon bad u Bor Singh; kumta u Rajah Rijon un shimti ia ka Ri lum ryngkat bad ka Laitkynsew bad ka Sohra Rim kaba shong shnong da u Khasi katba ka Ri Bhoi ba shong u Garo bad u Mikir kan hap hapoh u Bor Singh u ban peit ruh ia ka dwar Bordwar. Imat u Hudson u la shu tyrwa beit kumto khlem da sngewthuh bha ia ka Riti hiar pateng Syiem ha ka Hima Nongkhlaw. U lyoh u la kah dum ia ka Hima Nongkhlaw, ka bym ju kwah iapait iapra. Ngi kynmaw ba u Konrai mynwei dalade hi u la leit pyndem ia u Hain Singh, u Syiem-shnat ka Mawmluh ban pynbna ba ka kam kad hima kam dei ban don bynta ha ka khlieh synshar u

Khasi. Ka shnat Mawmluh hi ka long ka shnat khaii nar bakhraw kaba pynhiar ia u nar u ser bad ka atiar nar bun jaid sha dkhar bad sha war. La donkam ban don haduh Lai myntri ban iarap ia u Syiem ha Mawmluh. Ngi kynmaw ba ki syiem Nongkhlaw kim ai lad ia ka kwah mon ha ka Hima bad mynshwa ki ju leit pyndem ia ki Sohra rim bad Mawphu kiba don hapoh ka Hima shipor, shuwa ba ka Mawphu ka kynriah na ka Hima Nongkhlaw bad hap ha ka Hima Sohra U Hudson um lah ban tyrwa ban phiah ia ka Hima namar bym pat biang ki Myntri, u la dei shwa ban thung bad pynskhem ia ki bad twad jingmut na ki ia uno ki mon. Lada kim lah iabeit, ki Sordar kiba bat ia ka rai, kin rai bad ka Sorkar pat kan pynskhem. Kumta namar kane ka jingtyrwa ba utei u sahep u la buh, ka Hima ka la sah khlem syiem katto katne por. U Bor Singh Raja ha ka shithi kaba 4 tarik Jylliew 1856 sha u Agent u Governor General ka India lam mihngi shatei, kaba u hi da la ka kti u la soi ha ka dak Bengali bad kaba la pynkylla phareng de, u la pynrem ia u sahep Hudson ba u pyrkhat ban iarap ia u Rijon uba buaid tanglang bad ba um long ruh uba kot pyrkhat. U hi u la die duh ia ka hok bad um lah ban dawa pat ia ka. U la kynnoh ruh ba u la khroh ia ki Myntri da ka tyngka. Ha ka por ba u Rijon u la aiti ha 49 u Jidor, ka Sorkar ka la pdiang beit ia ka jingia aiti khet kumto khlem da ia kynjoh ktien bad u nongthung syiem ka hima bad khlem da pyntip da u kyrwoh uba biang. Wei haba shisien ka la pdiang ia ka jingpynbeit ki ar syiem, balei mynta pat ka kynjoh ktien na u paitbah

bad ia u Jidor ruh la thung da ka sorkar bad um dei da u paitbah. Lada u Rijon u aiti ia la ka khet ha u Jidor bad ba ka Sorkar ruh ka pynskhem, ka jingaiti u Jidor ha u Bor Singh kaba la pyntip mynta la saw snem, shibnai bad 14 sngi ruh bad kaba khlem don uba iapyrshah ruh ka dei ban ieng. Ha Nongkhlaw u pyrsa trai u hiar pateng ia u knii. Lada ym don pyrsa trai pat, ka khet ka leit sha u pyrsa ksiew. U Bor Singh u long u pyrsa ksiew u Jidor namar ki hymmen bad para kynthei u Jidor kim don khun shnrang. Ia u Jidor la shah ban long syiem da ka Sorkar khlem da rai u paitbah, bad ka Sorkar ka la pynskhem da ka sannad ba u long u Syiem ka Hima Nongkhlaw. Hynrei u Bor Singh u pyrshah ban phiah ia ka Hima namar ym don daw kaba biang, lym kumta kiwei ki Hima kiba khlainbor ruh kin hap ha kajuh ka apot hadien ha bud. U la kdew ba ha u bnai Baisack 1252 ia u Rijon la pynkynriah na Bordwar namar u la synshar sniew. U Rijon ruh u la ud la nam ba u Jidor um shym la bat la ka kular. Um ju ai baibam lane ka bhah na ka jingmih ka Hima bad shisien u la set phatok pynban ia u Rijon ha Sohra hadien ba u la mudui ha u saheb bishar. Ha ka shithi kaba 1 2 Joisto 1 263 BS lane 27 Jymmang 1 856 u Rijon u la thoh ba ka Riti ka shah tang ia u pyrsa trai ban long u Syiem. Lada ym don pyrsa pat, ki Sordar bad ki Syiem kynthei ki jied ia uno uno na ka iing syiem, uba da palat liam ha ka jingtbit, ka jingshemphang bad ka im hok. U Rijon u la bat ia ka hok syiem namar u dei u pyrsa u Konrai Syiem bad u Tirot u la shu long tang u nongpynkhmih shipor. Te ynda u Tirot u la phet sha Dacca, la kyntiew

khet ia u da ki myntri. U la dawa ba u Bor Singh um lah ban hiar pateng namar u Jidor um shym long syiem na la ka hok tynrai.U Rijon hi um shym la iasoh ruh bad u Tirot ha ka thma pyrshah ia ki phareng. Kat kum ka soskular ba la iateh bad ka sorkar, u Rijon u 50 lah ban shimt*. ia kano kano ka kam bishar bad kino kino ki mudui. kiba pyrshah ia ka rai jong u, lah ban phah pat ia ki sha ka Kashari Sorkar. U la dawa ba kum u Syiem Nongkhlaw u dei ruh u Syiem jong ka Dwar Borduwar. U Bor Singh u la pyntip ba u long u ksiew jong ka Phet, uba long knii ia ka da u Jidor. U Hudson pat u pyrkhat ba u Rijon ha ki snem ba hadien u la kham kylla khyndiat ha ka jingim jong u kum u briew uba kham bha bad kurnta lah ban pyrkhat ba un ioh ia ka bhah hapohkahima.
